Is Larnaca still being underestimated?

While investor attention often gravitates toward Cyprus's more expensive established markets, Larnaca deserves a closer look. International airport connectivity, an active coastal economy and ongoing development interest give the city a different investment profile from Cyprus's larger markets.

The question is not whether Larnaca is changing. It is whether investors are paying attention early enough.

Is Larnaca undervalued, or has the market already caught on?
